panels.alt: MX Modular button row with USB and BYPASS buttons for channels 1 to 8 and the 1-8 USB POST FADER button
panels.heading: Input selection and bypass

items.name: Input selector
items.label: USB
items.text: One per channel 1–8. Unlit: audio comes from the analog DB25 connector. Lit: from the USB connection.

items.name: 500 slot bypass
items.label: BYPASS
items.text: Sends the unprocessed signal straight to the fader, past the 500 series module, or with no module inserted.

items.name: USB post fader
items.label: 1-8 USB POST FADER
items.text: Unlit: USB records channels 1–8 pre-fader, straight after the 500 slot. Lit: post-fader, with fader, crossfader and mute.

panels.alt: MX Modular INSERT buttons for channels 1 to 8
panels.heading: Channel insert

items.name: Insert return
items.label: INSERT
items.text: Lit: the insert return from the back panel DB25 is active. The send is always active.
